players.product: PCIe Gen6 fabric switches (Scorpio), retimers (Aries), AECs (Torus), CXL memory controllers (Leo) for AI racks

quarterly_data.signal: Astera Labs' 10-K: Advanced Semiconductor Engineering (ASE) is one of the companies that assemble, package and test its integrated circuits, and Astera also relies on a small, limited number of other manufacturing partners for its modules, boards and IC substrates. Astera generally does not have long-term contracts requiring its third-party manufacturing partners to supply capacity, materials or services, and substantially all of its purchases are on a purchase order basis.

Astera Labs' 10-K: in October 2022 it issued a Customer Warrant to Amazon NV Investment Holdings LLC whose unvested shares may vest over the contract term contingent on specified tranches of global payments by Amazon and its affiliates to Astera Labs; on February 5, 2026 it entered into a further warrant agreement with Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC. The filing does not name the products Amazon purchases.

contracts.signal: Astera Labs' 10-K: it uses a fabless manufacturing model and partners with TSMC to fabricate all of its ICs; TSMC is its sole manufacturing partner for integrated circuits and Astera has not qualified another source. TSMC has increased, and may increase in the future, the wafer prices Astera pays.
